Line Width Recommendations: Recommended line width is derived from nozzle diameter and extrusion role. Typical perimeter width: 100-110% of nozzle diameter; external perimeter: 95-105%; solid infill: 110-130%; sparse infill: 120-150%; first layer: 120-140%. Maintain width <= 80% of layer height * (square corner factor) for sharp features.
